i.norm: Verifies that {@link NumericEntityUnescaper} correctly unescapes a numeric entity whose code point lies outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (a "supplementary" character).
"𐰢" is the XML numeric entity for decimal code point 68642 (U+10C22), a supplementary character that Java encodes as the UTF-16 surrogate pair U+D803 U+DC22.
